newsitem.title: USA: Emergent Group acquires all of Reedy River.
newsitem.headline: Emergent Group acquires all of Reedy River.

text.p: Emergent Group Inc said Tuesday that it has acquired the balance of Reedy River Ventures, a South Carolina limited partnership mezzanine lender, from the group of individual investors who were partners in Reedy River for $5.9 million.
Emergent Group, which served as manager of Reedy River, had previously owned a 12.78 percent interest in the partnership.
The acquisition price of about $5.9 million was paid in Emergent stock.
The assets of Reedy River consisted of five loans and cash having a book value of about $5.9 million.
This transaction will have no significant effect on Emergent Group's 1997 earnings per share, it said.
